title: Everything Edible
description: Makes every block and item edible by adding sugar to it!
body:
## Everything Edible

**This datapack allows you to make any `item` and `block` edible! To do this, take the `item` itself and add `sugar` to the craft. And voila — you've got an edible thing.**

---

### **Food Balance:**

*   **`cake`:** Now restores **`14` hunger points** and **`2.8` saturation**, but takes **twice as long** to eat.
*   **`dried_kelp_block`:** Is now edible. Restores **`9` hunger** and **`5.4` saturation**. Takes **`3.6` seconds** to eat.
*   **`egg`:** **`2`** hunger, **`1.2`** saturation.
*   **`wheat`:** **`1`** hunger, **`0.6`** saturation.
*   **`sugar_cane`:** **`1`** hunger, **`0.2`** saturation.
*   **`cocoa_beans`:** **1** hunger, **`0.4`** saturation.
*   **`mushroom`:** **`2`** hunger, **`0.4`** saturation. *(`red_mushroom` gives poison!)*
*   **`mushroom_block`:** **`8`** hunger, **`1.6`** saturation. *(`red_mushroom_block` gives poison!)*
*   **`cactus`:** **`1`** hunger, **`0.1`** saturation. *(doesn't hurt when eaten.)*
*   **`bamboo`:** **`1`** hunger, **`0.2`** saturation.
*   **`bamboo_block`:** **`9`** hunger, **`1.8`** saturation.
*   **`sugar`:** **`1`** hunger, **`0.2`** saturation.

---

**Please note:**
*   You CANNOT remove the edibility trait in any way (except for blocks that can be placed and items that can be simply re-crafted — this property will disappear for them).
*   Edible items do NOT stack with their non-edible counterparts.
*   **Important:** The edible items and blocks created by crafting with sugar will NOT fill your hunger bar. However, the specific food items listed in the **"Food Balance"** section above have their own custom hunger and saturation values (and effects, as noted).
*   Any new consumption effects (like `poison`) are explicitly described in the list above. Otherwise, there are no other consequences upon consumption (for example, if you eat `TNT`, you will not explode).
